title: x187_priv / x187_pub Core Codegen (x181 / x185 / x187_encode) Speedup & -O2 --nodrop
patches: O2E-1a: Direct-to-X187Build fast movq imm64 + o2e_push_mem32 + ALU/test/shift helpers (100% bit-identical to x187_encode)

O2E-1b: w7c_fast_inst_c fast-path dispatch for top-15 opcodes (movq, movl, movabsq, cmpq, cmpl, addq, addl, subq, subl, andq, andl, orq, orl, xorq, xorl, testq, testl, shrq, shlq, shrl, shll, leaq, call, ret, pushq, popq)
O2E-2a: Gate x186_private_body on o2e_has_mem_body(body) (100% bit-identical when no mem ops)
O2E-2b: Gate x191_loop_reads + x191_loop_scores in x191_joint_reads on x190_register_loop(body) (100% bit-identical)
O2E-2c: Single-pass liveness in x190_j_selected when !x190_register_loop(body), skipping 2-pass x190_l_fixed (100% bit-identical)
O2E-2d: Lightweight x185_transient_frame(x181_register_frame(...)) for trivial non-loop functions (sz < 8) in x190_joint_frame

O2E-3: Route cold public segments (weak cross-module stubs & is_direct==True cold thunk wrappers) in w8_tr_emit_pub -O2 mode through s10c_pub_emit_fast while keeping all is_direct==False strong public segments on full -O2

ab_n8_o0_minted_compiler_slice_o2.note: Apples-to-apples A/B using -O0-minted n8_base vs n8_o2e (m07+m08+m09 patched), 3-run median on CPU 7

key_diagnostic_findings: On m09_zero.bend -O2 (n7_o2), x187_pub (5,090 public segments) takes 84,657 ms (61.6% of total 137.45 s compile time), while x187_priv (451 private fns) takes 3,208 ms (2.3%) and x198pw_plan takes 40,692 ms (29.6%).

On compiler_slice.bend -O2, O2E-1 + O2E-2 + O2E-3 gave modest gain (~6% on pub, ~0% on priv before O2-B gates w4_post_select/w7_post_select_full), confirming that in un-gated x187_priv the dominant cost is inside w4_post_select/w7_post_select_full (O2-B) and the 12-pass x198n_normalized_h IR pipeline rather than x187_encode or x190_l_fixed alone.

Because n7_o2's Wave 16 K=10 S10-H mint omits 10 cross-module p113d stubs (including w7_br_871) and has the Wave 16 x198o_progress_get -O2 hang (owned by O2-C), full 64/64 -O2 + 15/15 Observer -O2 + 8-benchmark verification must be re-run after composing O2-E with O2-C's Wave 16 fix.
